1. Declared three stopping/restart triggers upfront (best_so_far_above, failures_at_least, last_gain_at_most) and a formal (non-substantive) prior pick.
2. Checked the baseline model: weak, Sharpe ≈ 0.18 (all-years) / 0.25 (recent-weighted), turnover 0.042.
3. `init` anchored on feature 32+ (Sharpe 0.385); `extend_best` found [32+, 35-] at 0.483.

New anchor [33+] (0.382) extended to **[33+, 35-]** at Sharpe 0.491 (all-years) / 0.554 (recent-weighted) — a new best, and notably feature 35− paired with a feature-33-family long signal emerged as the best 2-feature combination from two different starting anchors, which gave some (weak) comfort that the pairing isn't pure noise.
